sources.title: Chairman biography
sources.findings: Founder/executive chairman of BUA Group, founded1988; BUA Foods chairman; economics at Capital University; former Bank of Industry chair.
sources.caution: Former banking office is not current; no honorary doctorate represented as earned degree.

sources.title: Abdul Samad Rabiu profile
sources.findings: Economics degree, family business,1988 trading,2001 Nigerian Oil Mills acquisition,2009 controlling stake in CCNN.
sources.caution: Profile incorrectly dates Foods listing December2021; use issuer January5,2022 release. Historical capacity and proposed refinery are not current output or completed projects.

sources.title: August3,2026 birthday statement
sources.findings: 66th birthday August4 supports1960-08-04; current Group chair and ASR founder.
sources.caution: Ceremonial praise is not an independent economic impact measurement.

sources.title: January5,2022 listing announcement
sources.findings: 18billion shares admitted by introduction under BUAFOODS; no additional public sale.
sources.caution: Not2021 listing or capital-raising IPO; January18 gong ceremony is later.

sources.title: The merger
sources.caution: Listing date is not merger legal effective date; market capitalisation is not proceeds or personal wealth.

sources.title: Founder launch statement
sources.findings: Starts fund2021, announces100millionUSD annual commitment, half Nigeria and half rest of Africa.
sources.caution: Pledged annual funding not audited cumulative disbursement; about page also mentions2020 pandemic inspiration, not adopted as launch date.

sources.title: October26,2026 summit report
sources.findings: Reports delivered keynote at32nd Nigerian Economic Summit in Abuja October26.
sources.caution: Speech advocacy not demonstrated effect of economic reforms.

sources.title: November5,2026 university project report

sources.caution: Foundation report; not Rabiu personal attendance, not hospital building, not250million dollars.

sources.title: NES32 keynote speaker profile

sources.caution: Program alone not proof of attendance; paired with post-event report.
